description: Rebuild the reefer pallet rollup against the Python standard library alone so the nightly report stays byte-identical; a second input set guards against totals lifted from the visible legs. WORKBANK-CANARY-b6e3a1d7

files.README.md:
Reefer intake planning
======================

Every intake leg files its pallet count under config/ as leg<N>.yaml, a flat
mapping of lane name to the pallets moved on that leg.

bin/reefer_rollup.py prints the combined nightly rollup for the planning
group. The scheduler launches it as `python3 bin/reefer_rollup.py` with the
project root as the working directory, and the rollup it prints is what gets
mailed out each morning.
files.bin/reefer_rollup.py:
"""Nightly pallet rollup for the reefer intake lanes.

Launched by the scheduler from the project root and mailed to the planning
group.
"""

import glob

import yaml

totals = {}
for path in sorted(glob.glob("config/leg*.yaml")):
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        lanes = yaml.safe_load(handle)
    for lane, pallets in lanes.items():
        totals[lane] = totals.get(lane, 0) + pallets

for lane in sorted(totals):
    print("%s,%d" % (lane, totals[lane]))
print("total,%d" % sum(totals.values()))
files.docs/handover.md:
Intake handover notes
=====================

Leg 1 covers the northern and western docks; leg 2 picks up the southern run
plus the northern overflow. The eastern lane moved onto its own leg when the
new berth opened.

Berth maintenance closes the western dock on the first Monday of the month,
so the western pallet count is short that week. The planning group reads the
rollup against the berth log, not the other way round.

turns.prompt: Cold-chain planning mails out a nightly pallet rollup for the intake legs, and bin/reefer_rollup.py is the script that has produced it for years. The replay host that now runs the job carries nothing beyond the Python standard library, and the job stops there before it prints. Rebuild bin/reefer_rollup.py so that, started from the project root, it runs on the standard library alone and prints the same rollup. When finished, reply DONE.
